what: Canadian versions of US-catalog products a Canadian printer can make. Handle <source>-ca, tagged ca, ACTIVE in the Canada market catalog and the Online Store only. Purely additive: the source keeps the US catalog and Canada did not sell these before, so nothing was swapped.
locality: A printer counted as Canadian only where Printify quotes Canada its OWN shipping lane within 7 days, never from the factory list. CLAUDE.md records why: the factory list shows CA facilities for Printify Choice that a regular listing is never quoted.
colourLoss: 25 of the 301 lose a colour the Canadian printer does not stock, worst being the three Make America tees at 4 colours down to 2 (Red and Royal Caribe gone). Overall 3,531 source variants became 3,239.

notBuilt.title: Customizable Warped Tour Themed Adult Tee

alsoWorthKnowing: 86 of the 303 candidates are Gildan 5000 or Comfort Colors 1717, where Global Fulfillment serves Canada at .79 against the best Canadian lane at .09, and covers the UK and Australia in the same listing. They were built as Canada-only listings because they have no -int version; extending the -int work to them would be cheaper and wider.

Ten products flipped to DRAFT during the run and fell out of their catalogs: four -int listings, six -uk rebuilds. Two live US source products did the same and left the US catalog. All twelve were restored to ACTIVE and republished, and the US catalog is back to its backed-up 521. The cause was not identified. Creating and publishing a sibling product is the only thing that touched them, and nothing in the build writes to a source, so it is most likely something in how Printify syncs a shop to Shopify. Worth re-checking after any future bulk build.
Three -ca products were created and then vanished from both Shopify and Printify, leaving stale ids in the state file. They were rebuilt.
